run_inference: run inference on a benchmark system with a checkpoint model and measure throughput and GPU memory
compare_results: compare candidate inference predictions against a baseline result and compute energy force and stress error metrics
format_report_table: format benchmark results dictionary into a human-readable table string with energy error force MAE and QPS columns
run_PerfCheckRunner: run a performance benchmark comparing candidate inference settings against an fp64 baseline across default test systems
load_baseline_cache: load cached baseline inference results from a JSON file if the cache key matches the expected checkpoint and systems
